arguments.sql:
WITH monthly_sales AS (
    SELECT s.prod_id,
           co.country_name AS country,
           t.calendar_month_number AS month,
           t.calendar_year AS year,
           SUM(s.amount_sold) AS sales_amount
    FROM main.sales AS s
    JOIN main.customers AS cu ON cu.cust_id = s.cust_id
    JOIN main.countries AS co ON co.country_id = cu.country_id
    JOIN main.times AS t ON t.time_id = s.time_id
    JOIN main.promotions AS p ON p.promo_id = s.promo_id
    JOIN main.channels AS ch ON ch.channel_id = s.channel_id
    WHERE co.country_name = 'France'
      AND p.promo_total_id = 1
      AND ch.channel_total_id = 1
      AND t.calendar_year BETWEEN 2019 AND 2021
    GROUP BY s.prod_id, co.country_name, t.calendar_month_number, t.calendar_year
),
yearly_sales AS (
    SELECT prod_id, country, month,
           MAX(CASE WHEN year = 2019 THEN sales_amount END) AS sales_2019,
           MAX(CASE WHEN year = 2020 THEN sales_amount END) AS sales_2020,
           MAX(CASE WHEN year = 2021 THEN sales_amount END) AS sales_2021
    FROM monthly_sales
    GROUP BY prod_id, country, month
)
SELECT month,
       COUNT(sales_2019) AS groups_2019,
       COUNT(sales_2020) AS groups_2020,
       COUNT(sales_2021) AS groups_2021,
       SUM(sales_2019 IS NULL AND sales_2020 IS NOT NULL) AS no_2019_from_2020,
       SUM(sales_2019 = 0) AS zero_2019,
       SUM(sales_2019 IS NOT NULL AND sales_2020 IS NOT NULL AND sales_2021 IS NULL) AS paired_without_2021,
       (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM main.currency AS fx
        WHERE fx.country = y.country AND fx.year = 2021 AND fx.month = y.month) AS fx_rows,
       (SELECT MIN(fx.to_us) FROM main.currency AS fx
        WHERE fx.country = y.country AND fx.year = 2021 AND fx.month = y.month) AS fx_rate
FROM yearly_sales AS y
GROUP BY country, month
ORDER BY month

projections AS (

WITH monthly_sales AS (
    SELECT s.prod_id,
           co.country_name AS country,
           t.calendar_month_number AS month,
           t.calendar_year AS year,
           SUM(s.amount_sold) AS sales_amount
    FROM main.sales AS s
    JOIN main.customers AS cu ON cu.cust_id = s.cust_id
    JOIN main.countries AS co ON co.country_id = cu.country_id
    JOIN main.times AS t ON t.time_id = s.time_id
    JOIN main.promotions AS p ON p.promo_id = s.promo_id
    JOIN main.channels AS ch ON ch.channel_id = s.channel_id
    WHERE co.country_name = 'France'
      AND p.promo_total_id = 1
      AND ch.channel_total_id = 1
      AND t.calendar_year BETWEEN 2019 AND 2021
    GROUP BY s.prod_id, co.country_name, t.calendar_month_number, t.calendar_year
),
monthly_averages AS (
    SELECT target.month,
           ROUND(AVG(
               ((y2020.sales_amount - y2019.sales_amount) / NULLIF(y2019.sales_amount, 0)
                * y2020.sales_amount + y2020.sales_amount) * COALESCE(fx.to_us, 1)
           ), 2) AS average_projected_sales_usd
    FROM monthly_sales AS target
    JOIN monthly_sales AS y2019
      ON y2019.prod_id = target.prod_id
     AND y2019.country = target.country
     AND y2019.month = target.month
     AND y2019.year = 2019
    JOIN monthly_sales AS y2020
      ON y2020.prod_id = target.prod_id
     AND y2020.country = target.country
     AND y2020.month = target.month
     AND y2020.year = 2020
    LEFT JOIN main.currency AS fx
      ON fx.country = target.country
     AND fx.year = target.year
     AND fx.month = target.month
    WHERE target.year = 2021
    GROUP BY target.month
),
ranked_months AS (
    SELECT average_projected_sales_usd,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY average_projected_sales_usd) AS position,
           COUNT(*) OVER () AS month_count
    FROM monthly_averages
    WHERE average_projected_sales_usd IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT AVG(average_projected_sales_usd) AS median_monthly_average_projected_sales_usd
FROM ranked_months
WHERE position IN ((month_count + 1) / 2, (month_count + 2) / 2)
LIMIT 1

SELECT AVG(average_projected_sales_usd) AS median_monthly_average_projected_sales_usd
FROM ranked_months
WHERE position IN ((month_count + 1) / 2, (month_count + 2) / 2)
LIMIT 1
